title: Orientation
description: auto: follows the page's box (wider than tall: one row per key, presses travel sideways; otherwise one column per key, presses travel up or down). Size the source or layer to change it.

title: Caps side
description: Where the key caps sit; presses travel away from them. auto: left when horizontal, bottom when vertical. start: left / top. end: right / bottom.

title: Scroll speed
description: How fast presses travel along the tape, in pixels per real second at the overlay's natural size (it scales with the page; rate mods are compensated). 100–3000.

title: Show press counts
description: Presses of this attempt under each key label.

title: Show keys per second
description: Live keys per second (presses in the last real second across all keys) and the attempt's peak.

title: Smoke lane (osu!)
description: Adds a lane for the osu! smoke key.

title: Bar colour
description: map: osu!, catch and mania bars take the tonal accent of the current map's background (taiko keeps don/kat colours). 18-lab: the colours below.

title: osu! colour
description: osu! K1/K2 bars (also the fallback when a map has no usable colour).

title: osu!mania colour
description: All mania columns. Mania lanes keep the current skin's column width proportions.

title: Backing
description: none: floats on the game (dark lane beds, a soft shade under the numbers). scrim: adds a soft shade behind it. panel: a solid panel.
